title: An herbal formulation "Shenshuaifu Granule" alleviates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity by suppressing inflammation and apoptosis through inhibition of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Jin, Xiaoming; He, Riming; Liu, Jiahui; Wang, Yuzhi; Li, Zhongtang; Jiang, Beibei; Lu, Jiandong; Yang, Shudong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方SSF缓解顺铂肾毒性，核心是TLR4/NF-kB炎症凋亡通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，仅分子对接为辅助，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Shenshuaifu Granule (SSF) is an in-hospital preparation approved by the Guangdong Food and Drug Administration of China. It has been clinically used against kidney diseases for more than 20 years with a definite curative effect. AIM OF THE STUDY: Cisplatin (CDDP) is a first-line chemotherapeutic drug in clinical practice, primarily excreted by the kidney with nephrotoxicity as a common side effect. Approximately 5-20% of cancer patients develop acute kidney injury (AKI) after chemotherapy; however, prevention and control strategies are currently unavailable. Therefore, it is important to identify safe and effective drugs that can prevent the nephrotoxicity of CDDP. SSF is an herbal formulation with 8 herbs, and has been used to protect the kidney in China. Nonetheless, its mechanism in relieving CDDP nephrotoxicity remains unclear. Therefore, this work attempt to prove that SSF can alleviate CDDP nephrotoxicity. We also explore its mechanism. MATERIALS AND METHODS: First, Thin Layer Chromatography (TLC) of a few herbs in SSF were performed for quality control. Several open-access databases were used to identify the active ingredients of SSF, their corresponding targets, and CDDP-induced nephrotoxicity targets. We performed Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI), Gene Ontology (GO), and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses. Next, the results of network pharmacology were validated using CDDP-induced nephrotoxicity mouse models. Renal function in the mice was assessed by analyzing the levels of serum creatinine (Scr) and blood urea nitrogen (BUN). On the other hand, renal damage was assessed by determining the level of tubular injury and apoptotic cells using Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) staining and Terminal Dutp Nick End-Labeling (TUNEL) staining, respectively. The expression of inflammatory and apoptotic-related targets including IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha, Cox-2, Bax, Bcl-2, Cleaved-caspase 3, and Cleaved-caspase 9 was determined using Western Blot (WB) and Immunohistochemistry (IHC). Furthermore, WB was used to analyze the expression of proteins associated with the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway in the kidneys of mice with CDDP-induced nephrotoxicity. Finally, molecular docking simulations were performed to evaluate the binding abilities between major active ingredients of SSF and core targets. RESULT: Through network pharmacology, we identified 127 active ingredients of SSF and their corresponding 134 targets. Additional screening identified 14 active ingredients and 17 targets for further analysis. In biological process (BP), the targets were enriched in inflammation and apoptosis, among others. In KEGG terms, they were enriched in apoptosis and NF-kappaB pathways. Animal experiments revealed that SSF significantly reduced the levels of Scr and BUN and prevented renal tubular damage in mice treated with CDDP. In addition, SSF inhibited inflammation and apoptosis by targeting the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway. Molecular docking revealed good binding capacities of active ingredients and core targets. CONCLUSION: In summary, the experimental findings were consistent with the network pharmacological predictions. SSF can inhibit inflammation and apoptosis by targeting the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway. Taken together, our data suggest that SSF is an alternative agent for the treatment of CDDP-induced nephrotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：肾衰复颗粒（SSF）是经中国广东省食品药品监督管理局批准的院内制剂，已在临床上用于治疗肾脏疾病超过20年，疗效确切。研究目的：顺铂（CDDP）是临床一线化疗药物，主要通过肾脏排泄，肾毒性是其常见副作用。约5-20%的癌症患者在化疗后发生急性肾损伤（AKI）；然而，目前尚无预防和控制策略。因此，寻找安全有效的药物以预防CDDP的肾毒性具有重要意义。SSF是一种由8味草药组成的复方制剂，在中国已被用于保护肾脏。然而，其缓解CDDP肾毒性的机制尚不清楚。因此，本研究旨在证明SSF能够减轻CDDP肾毒性，并探讨其机制。材料与方法：首先，对SSF中部分草药进行薄层色谱（TLC）以进行质量控制。利用多个开放数据库鉴定SSF的活性成分、其对应靶点及CDDP诱导的肾毒性靶点。我们进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）、基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析。接着，使用CDDP诱导的肾毒性小鼠模型验证网络药理学结果。通过分析血清肌酐（Scr）和血尿素氮（BUN）水平评估小鼠肾功能。另一方面，通过使用高碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色和末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶dUTP缺口末端标记（TUNEL）染色分别测定肾小管损伤程度和凋亡细胞来评估肾损伤。使用Western Blot（WB）和免疫组织化学（IHC）检测炎症和凋亡相关靶点（包括IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha、Cox-2、Bax、Bcl-2、Cleaved-caspase 3和Cleaved-caspase 9）的表达。此外，使用WB分析CDDP诱导肾毒性小鼠肾脏中与TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路相关蛋白的表达。最后，进行分子对接模拟以评估SSF主要活性成分与核心靶点之间的结合能力。结果：通过网络药理学，我们鉴定了SSF的127个活性成分及其对应的134个靶点。进一步筛选确定了14个活性成分和17个靶点用于后续分析。在生物过程（BP）中，靶点富集于炎症和凋亡等过程。在KEGG条目中，它们富集于凋亡和NF-kappaB通路。动物实验显示，SSF显著降低了CDDP处理小鼠的Scr和BUN水平，并预防了肾小管损伤。此外，SSF通过靶向TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路抑制炎症和凋亡。分子对接显示活性成分与核心靶点具有良好的结合能力。结论：总之，实验结果与网络药理学预测一致。SSF可通过靶向TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路抑制炎症和凋亡。综合来看，我们的数据表明SSF是治疗CDDP诱导肾毒性的替代药物。
